steps.title: Analyze User Request
steps.description: Examine simple notepad project files to plan core feature upgrades including search, note titles, editing, timestamps, and backward compatibility.

steps.title: Design Note Item Layout
steps.description: Create the note_item.xml layout file to arrange custom styling elements like note titles, snippets, and creation timestamps.

steps.title: Redesign Main Layout
steps.description: Modify activity_main.xml layout to incorporate a search bar, dual-input fields for note Title/Content, and state action buttons.

steps.title: Declare Note Data Structure
steps.description: Design static nested Note class to represent structured note payloads containing unique IDs, customized titles, body text, and timestamps.

steps.title: Implement Backward Compatible Loader
steps.description: Develop upgraded JSON deserializer capable of loading both classic notepad string arrays and modern structured note objects seamlessly.

steps.title: Build SharedPreferences Serializer
steps.description: Write a serialization mechanism inside MainActivity to store notes as structured JSON lists dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Custom BaseAdapter
steps.description: Create a robust custom adapter to inflate search-responsive lists with formatted timestamps and text truncation controls.

steps.title: Integrate Real-Time Search Filter
steps.description: Add TextWatcher to search bar allowing users to dynamically filter notes by both title and content instantly.

steps.title: Implement Note Click Edit State
steps.description: Bind list item click listener to switch view states to editor mode, populate input forms, and transition button behaviors.

steps.title: Implement Unified Save and Update Controller
steps.description: Build cohesive validation logic to seamlessly differentiate new note storage from updating existing notes in editing state.

steps.title: Build Selective Delete Handler
steps.description: Implement standard AlertDialog confirmation on item long clicks to securely remove matching unique entries.

steps.title: Instate Editor Reset
steps.description: Attach click listeners to clean temporary inputs and restore launcher configurations safely.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Code Standards
steps.description: Examine source code structures to verify clean, reliable compilation without any restricted lambda features.

steps.title: Building Simple Notepad
steps.description: Initiate build command sequence to produce the newly updated, feature-rich notepad application.
